ios.desc:
Hamsey — Hyperlocal Networking for Builders & Professionals
Hamsey is a proximity-based networking platform designed to help founders, creators, investors, and professionals connect with credible people around them in real life.
In co-working spaces, campuses, events, and business hubs, talented individuals often work just meters apart without ever meeting. Hamsey makes these connections visible and actionable.
The platform helps people network with credible individuals within close range and grow a hyperlocal professional network. 


Connect With Purpose, Not Randomness
Hamsey is built for meaningful professional interactions — collaboration, learning, hiring, investing, and idea exchange.
Discover people nearby such as:
• Founders & startup teams
• Investors & operators
• Creators & builders
• Designers, engineers, and professionals
• Students & aspiring entrepreneurs
Every profile includes basic career information, helping you understand who you’re connecting with and keeping interactions respectful and productive. 


Turn Shared Spaces Into Opportunity
Co-working spaces and professional environments host a large pool of talented individuals but initiating conversations can feel awkward or uncertain.
Hamsey helps you reach out with confidence through simple connection requests, making real-world networking more accessible.
People hesitate to approach others due to awkward first interactions or fear of judgment — Hamsey removes that barrier. 

Perfect for:
• Co-working spaces
• Startup ecosystems
• Conferences & meet-ups
• Business campuses
• Work-friendly cafés

Grow Your Hyperlocal Network Faster
Unlike traditional platforms that rely on distant online discovery, Hamsey focuses on people already around you.
This enables:

• Early users for new products
• Faster feedback on ideas
• Access to domain expertise nearby
• Potential collaborations
• Hiring opportunities
• Investor connections

Local networking will help people get support from people around who’re in the same domain and grow their audience faster than traditional platforms alone. 


Professional & Respectful Environment
Hamsey is designed for productive interactions.

• Profile-based networking
• User controls over visibility
• Report & block tools
• Community guidelines promoting respect
• Built for professional use not casual socialising

Make Every Room Smarter
Great opportunities often exist in the same space they just aren’t visible.
Hamsey transforms everyday environments into powerful
